An '''unidentified [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]]''' served as the manager of the [[White Thranta Shipping Company]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The company was located on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], near the city of [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]]. It was outwardly a shipping company, but secretly kidnapped victims for [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]].
